title: The £5 Chess Piece
post: It sat in a drawer for 55 years. Then it sold for almost $1,000,000. #chess #history #lewischessmen #antiques #storytime

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

_chatterbox._name: Trailet narrador (Fish sample) cloned locally with Chatterbox

phrases.text: This chess piece sat in a drawer for fifty-five years.
phrases.say: [curious] This chess piece sat in a drawer... for fifty-five years.

phrases.text: Then it sold for almost a million dollars.
phrases.say: [excited] Then it sold for almost a MILLION dollars!

phrases.text: It's a Lewis chessman. And these little guys? Total legends.
phrases.say: [mischievously] It's a Lewis chessman. And these little guys? Total legends.

phrases.text: A sand dune gives up a hidden hoard. Ninety-three pieces, carved from walrus tusk. Yes, walrus.
phrases.say: [mysterious] A sand dune gives up a hidden hoard. [amazed] Ninety-three pieces, carved from walrus tusk. [laughs] Yes... walrus.

phrases.text: They're so famous, copies even show up in Harry Potter.
phrases.say: [excited] They're so famous, copies even show up in Harry Potter!

phrases.text: But here's the twist. Five pieces were never found.
phrases.say: [serious] But here's the twist. Five pieces... were never found.

phrases.text: 1964. An Edinburgh antiques dealer buys this piece for five pounds.
phrases.say: [storytelling] 1964. An Edinburgh antiques dealer buys this piece... for five pounds.

phrases.text: He writes in his ledger: walrus tusk warrior. He had absolutely no idea.
phrases.say: [sarcastic] He writes in his ledger: walrus tusk warrior. [laughs] He had absolutely no idea.

phrases.text: After he dies, it ends up in his daughter's drawer.
phrases.say: [softly] After he dies, it ends up in his daughter's drawer.

phrases.text: 2019. The family takes it to Sotheby's. And the experts get very excited.
phrases.say: 2019. The family takes it to Sotheby's. [excited] And the experts get VERY excited.

phrases.text: They believe it's one of the five missing pieces.
phrases.say: They believe it's one of the five missing pieces.

phrases.text: seven hundred and thirty-five thousand pounds.
phrases.say: [shouting] SEVEN hundred and thirty-five THOUSAND pounds!

phrases.text: Which means four may still be out there.
phrases.say: [whispers] Which means... four may still be out there.
